## Dermatological Comparison & Action Mechanisms

Elevated free testosterone and DHT stimulate facial oil glands to produce thick sebum along the chin and jawline. Spearmint tea polyphenols decrease circulating free androgens.

## How To Layer Both Actives Safely

Steep 1 tea bag or 2.5g loose spearmint leaves in hot water for 7-10 minutes. Consume 1 cup in the morning and 1 cup in the evening consistently for 6-8 weeks.
